turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television.
And how was that for you?
I added everything up, the debt is nineteen thousand pounds with the credit cards and the payday loan.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. Yes, it was like that.
What went through your mind then?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say.
Tell me more about that.
It is twelve days since my last bet, the longest in three years.
Tell me more about that.
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy. That is how it was.
What went through your mind then?
I went to Gamblers Anonymous at the community centre and a man named Frank shared a story just like mine.
What went through your mind then?
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest. I keep coming back to it.
Mm-hm. Go on.
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today.
And how was that for you?
Meera stayed but she sleeps in the spare room and barely speaks to me.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts.
Let us stop here for today.
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
